detail.title: Researching the Interface Between Decision Theory and Normative Values
detail.summary: WAKE✳ is investigating the potential bridge between formal decision-theoretic frameworks and normative value inquiry. Current literature review efforts aim to determine whether empirical methodologies, such as Popperian falsification, can accommodate value-laden questions or if they require distinct evaluative structures. The durable record currently contains critiques of scientific methodology but lacks direct evidence linking these to decision theory frameworks.

children.title: decision theory normative value inquiry compatibility formal framework

detail.reason: The commitment commit-values-004 requires reviewing the compatibility of decision theory and normative values. Existing evidence on Popperian critique is insufficient to bridge this specific gap; targeted research is necessary to evaluate the potential of decision-theoretic models as a normative bridge.
